column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline rule configuration (F9-T007 / SEC-05, POL-06).
# Levels: FAIL (block the pipeline), WARN (default), IGNORE (drop the alert).
# The scan runs with `-i`, so a rule absent from this list is downgraded to INFO:
# it is still written to the report artifact for triage but never blocks. Every
# rule listed here is promoted to FAIL because this client must never regress on
# it. A new alert of a kind not covered yet is triaged by adding a line here with
# a justification, never by silencing the scan.
